description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Tool' containing static utility functions for graph creation, including geometric calculations, Bezier curve computations, rotation, and linear regression.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Tool
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for geometric and mathematical operations used in graph rendering.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns the average of two points.

methods.name: mirror
methods.description: Mirrors a point in another point by a specified factor.

methods.name: controlPoint
methods.description: Calculates a Bezier control point based on two points and a smoothing factor.

methods.name: bezier
methods.description: Calculates a point on a Bezier curve for a given parameter t.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates a point around a center by a specified angle.

methods.name: close2zero
methods.description: Rounds a number to zero if it is within a specified decimal threshold.

methods.name: calculateArcDimensionAndCenter
methods.description: Calculates the dimensions and center point of an arc segment based on start and end angles.

methods.name: calculateLinearRegression
methods.description: Performs linear regression on a dataset to find slope and intercept.
